messages.author: 24987fb3fdada5f4
messages.subject: How to run useR2007.rhtml
parts:
Hi All,

I was trying to run useR2007.rhtml with follwoing apache conf.

<Directory "/var/www/html/">
    Options Indexes FollowSymLinks MultiViews
    AllowOverride None
    Order allow,deny
    Allow from all
</Directory>

<Directory /var/www/html/brew>
        ROutputErrors
        SetHandler r-script
        RHandler brew::brew
</Directory>

When I do http://localhost/brew/useR2007.rhtml, it shows following error message
<!--
Error in brew("/brew/useR2007plot.rhtml") : No valid input

Function brew returned an object of 'try-error'.
-->
I have reset the code "<div id="plot"><% brew('/test/brew/useR2007plot.rhtml') %></div> " in useR2007.rhtml to "<div id="plot"><% brew('/brew/useR2007plot.rhtml') %></div> ". I have also installed Cairo and Hmisc properly.

In error_log I find following error message,

[Tue Mar 13 09:19:24 2012] [error] [client 10.3.2.36] File does not exist: /var/www/html/prototype.js, referer: http://mlsc.ddi.org/brew/useR2007.rhtml

Hence can you please tell me whats going wrong here?

Regards,
Prashantha
